meta.name: ansoff-matrix
meta.description: Map evidence-backed growth options across the Ansoff Matrix with risk-rated sequencing. Use when the question is where the next tranche of growth comes from, and at what risk.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 规划增长策略并评估风险
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要系统分析增长机会并排序风险。
copy.tagline_en: Plan growth strategies and assess risks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to systematically analyze growth opportunities and sequence risks.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按安索夫矩阵的四象限（市场渗透、市场开发、产品开发、多元化）整理公司的增长选择，并为每个候选行动附上证据信号和风险评级，最后给出推荐执行顺序和打破顺序的假设；输出格式固定，不凭空编造市场规模。
howto.when: 当问题涉及下一波增长从哪里来、风险多大时触发；例如用户要求按安索夫矩阵分析增长选项时。

say.text: 用安索夫矩阵分析我们明年增长选项，给出证据和风险。
say.note: 会输出四象限图景和推荐顺序。

say.text: 把我们的多元化提议放到安索夫矩阵里检验证据。
say.note: 会评估信号是否支撑高风险做法。

say.text: 基于现有研究，按安索夫矩阵列出增长路径顺序。
say.note: 会利用会话中的情报填充矩阵。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude organizes growth options across the four Ansoff quadrants (penetration, development, diversification). Each move must cite documented signals and a risk rating, then a recommended sequence with its breaking assumption. Output schema is fixed; no invented market sizes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the question is where the next tranche of growth comes from and at what risk, e.g. asking for an Ansoff matrix analysis of growth options.

say_en.text: Map our next-year growth options in an Ansoff matrix with evidence and risk.
say_en.note: Returns four quadrants and a recommended sequence.

say_en.text: Pressure-test our diversification pitch against the Ansoff quadrant.
say_en.note: Checks whether signals support the high-risk move.

say_en.text: Using our session research, sequence growth paths per Ansoff.
say_en.note: Fills the matrix from existing intelligence.
